description: Masks the personal data of a file (PDF, Word, Excel, CSV, text, image) and saves the masked copy next to the original as "<name> (masked)". The file is sent to Redactic in the EU for detection and deleted there once the copy is saved. Returns the path of the masked copy and a session_id for restore_file. The original file is not changed.

detection_mode.description: How thoroughly the text is read. "accurate" (default) takes a second look at places, addresses and organisations. "fast" skips it and answers sooner.

language.description: Language of the text as a two-letter code, as a hint.

regions.description: Countries of the document as ISO codes, for example ["IT","DE"]. Leave out to detect the country.

types.description: Entity types to mask, for example ["PERSON","IBAN"]. Leave out for all types.

name: mask_file
title: Mask a file
